theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+0.99%) and Communication Svcs (+0.73%) led the market today, while Materials (-2.74%) and Real Estate (-0.63%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.45% versus -0.42% for defensives and -0.62% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.51%, Dow +0.49%, Nasdaq +0.68% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.50%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 1.35% to 16.86, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.78% to $4,100.90, crude oil was little changed at $84.85, and bitcoin slipped 2.96% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
